description: This file defines a data model class 'Note' and a related 'NoteFields' class that contains database field constants. It provides methods for creating notes, copying, serialization/deserialization, and date formatting, tailored for a note-taking application.

classes.name: NoteFields
classes.description: Contains string constants representing database column names for notes, and a list of all field names.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Represents a note with properties like id, title, content, category, color, pin status, creation and update timestamps, along with utility methods for copying, serialization, and date formatting.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Note instance, overriding specified fields.

methods.name: dateLabel
methods.description: Returns a formatted date string for a given DateTime.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Constructs a Note object from a map (likely from database or JSON).

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Serializes the Note object into a map suitable for database storage or JSON.
